visualCharacteristics: Horizontal rail of key figures with large brand-coloured numbers above short labels; centred when all fit, otherwise prev/next arrows.
contentPattern: One row per figure: cell 1 the figure value, cell 2 its label.
usage: Use to display a row of key figures or statistics with short labels.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any KPI row by adding one two-cell row (value | label) per figure.
